scope: 6 lunar educational anchors / 12 distinct official images; not live map data or generated terrain

coordinateNote.zh: 采用 NASA Apollo Lunar Surface Journal 的 0.67409°N、23.47298°E。是静海基地的区域锚点，与宁静海整体中心分开；非导航精度，未验证与显示纹理逐像素配准。
coordinateNote.en: NASA Apollo Lunar Surface Journal coordinates: 0.67409°N, 23.47298°E. An anchor for Tranquility Base, distinct from the center of Mare Tranquillitatis; not navigation-grade, with pixel-level texture registration unverified.

coordinateNote.zh: USGS Feature 3691 的当前区域中心为8.35°N、30.83°E；不是阿波罗11号坐标。区域内图像可以展示西南部或局部皱脊，不能将整片月海缩成单个着陆点。纹理配准未逐像素验证。
coordinateNote.en: Current regional center from USGS Feature 3691: 8.35°N, 30.83°E, not Apollo 11's coordinates. Images show southwestern terrain or local wrinkle ridges within the mare, not one landing point representing the whole region. Pixel-level registration unverified.

coordinateNote.zh: 采用USGS Feature 6163当前中心43.30°S、11.22°W；NASA旧资料另列43.37°S、348.68°E，不混用两个控制网的数值。仅区域级锚点，纹理配准未逐像素验证。
coordinateNote.en: Current USGS Feature 6163 center: 43.30°S, 11.22°W. Older NASA material lists 43.37°S, 348.68°E; values from different control networks are not mixed. Regional anchor; pixel-level registration unverified.

coordinateNote.zh: USGS Feature 1296当前中心为9.62°N、20.08°W。是陨石坑区域中心，不是中央峰顶的单点；旧照片说明中的近似10°N、20°W只用于说明，不混作新精确值。纹理配准未逐像素验证。
coordinateNote.en: Current USGS Feature 1296 center: 9.62°N, 20.08°W. A crater-region center, not a surveyed summit. Older captions' approximate 10°N, 20°W are not mixed into a new precise pair. Pixel-level registration unverified.

coordinateNote.zh: 使用几何南极90°S作为整个极区的教育锚点；经度0°只是极点坐标约定，南极上所有经度交汇。不是Cabeus撞击点、沙克尔顿坑中心或任何载人着陆点。
coordinateNote.en: The geographic pole at 90°S anchors the broad polar region; 0° longitude is only a convention because all meridians meet there. Not the Cabeus impact point, Shackleton center or a crewed landing site.

name.zh: 嫦娥四号着陆区·天河基地

coordinateNote.zh: 采用USGS Feature 15781/LOLA 2011的天河基地近似坐标45.45°S、177.60°E，对应冯·卡门陨石坑内嫦娥四号着陆点。不是整片南极—艾特肯盆地或几何南极；未做导航级或纹理逐像素配准。
coordinateNote.en: USGS Feature 15781 / LOLA 2011 approximate Statio Tianhe coordinates: 45.45°S, 177.60°E, for Chang'e 4 inside Von Kármán crater. Not the entire South Pole–Aitken basin or geographic pole; neither navigation-grade nor pixel-registered.

files.dateKind: acquired during July 1969 surface activity; no exact UTC exposure day asserted

caption.zh: 阿姆斯特朗拍摄的奥尔德林与鹰号登月舱支腿，AS11-40-5902；是1969年7月阿波罗11号月面活动照片。来源页面用着陆日标注整项任务，这里不将其误当成照片精确 UTC 时间。
caption.en: Armstrong's photograph of Aldrin beside an Eagle landing leg, AS11-40-5902, during Apollo 11's July 1969 surface activity. The source labels the mission's landing day; this is not asserted as an exact UTC exposure time.

caption.zh: Ranger 8 B045：1965-02-20距月面约511千米时拍摄，画面约95千米宽；左上为萨宾陨石坑，属于宁静海西南部。阿波罗11号着陆点约在画面右侧30千米外，不在此图中。
caption.en: Ranger 8 B045, acquired February 20, 1965 from about 511 km altitude; roughly 95 km across. Sabine crater is upper left in southwestern Mare Tranquillitatis. Apollo 11's site lies about 30 km to the right, outside this frame.

caption.en: PIA13079: a wrinkle ridge in Mare Tranquillitatis basalt plains, about 1.25 km across. Released April 27, 2010; not an individual acquisition date. A local orbital view within the mare, not the whole mare or Apollo site.

caption.en: LRO oblique view of Tycho's central peaks acquired June 10, 2011; the peak complex spans about 15 km. Low sunlight emphasizes relief and shadows. An orbital photograph, not a ground photograph or locally generated terrain.

caption.zh: LRO于2019-01-30斜视嫦娥四号着陆区；箭头间的亮点只有约两个原始像素，玉兔二号在这张图中不可分辨。背景是冯·卡门陨石坑西侧坑壁，不是月面相机近景。
caption.en: LRO's January 30, 2019 oblique view of the Chang'e 4 site. The lander between arrows spans only about two native pixels; Yutu-2 is not resolved here. The background is Von Kármán's western wall, not a surface-camera close-up.

caption.zh: 2019-01-31 LROC NAC再次拍摄：箭头分别标出着陆器与玉兔二号，北向右上；玉兔二号仅约两个原始像素。这是着陆后约四周的轨道观察，不是1月3日落月照片。
caption.en: LROC NAC's January 31, 2019 observation: arrows identify the lander and Yutu-2, north toward upper right. The rover spans only about two native pixels. Orbital follow-up four weeks after landing, not a January 3 touchdown photograph.
